reviewed_findings.original_message: Make sure disabling CSRF protection is safe here.
reviewed_findings.resolution: Enabled Django CSRF middleware; bearer-only API views retain their standard DRF behavior.

reviewed_findings.original_message: Make sure publicly writable directories are used safely here.
reviewed_findings.resolution: Replaced the generic /tmp mount with dedicated /sandbox-tmp, mode 0700 and matching UID/GID. Effective tmpfs and working directory are verified after Docker create. Policy-tamper and real containment tests cover the hardened boundary. No Sonar rule suppression is used.
